{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend scarf in copper and light beige with a wide collar designed to wrap under the chin, oversized relaxed fit, length 180 cm, #c08b5d for the left side mirroring her hair and #f4dcc2 for the right.
Merino wool turtleneck sweater with a structured ribbed neckline, crew neck cut, long sleeves, cream color, soft knit fabric.
Straight-leg dark denim jeans with a high waistband, mid-length hem hitting above the ankle, #2a2a35 indigo wash, sturdy cotton twill.
Leather ankle boots with a low stacked heel, pointed toe design, black finish, smooth calfskin leather.
Gold-toned delicate chain necklace featuring a small geometric pendant, adjustable length, polished brass metal.
This outfit honors her specific wish to wear a scarf that sits uniquely under the chin while complementing her dual-toned hair with matching copper and beige shades. The wool textures provide warmth for an autumn day walk, creating a cozy yet put-together look suitable for everyday occasions. The dark denim grounds the lighter tones of the top and scarf, ensuring the ensemble feels balanced and intentional rather than overly bright or chaotic."}
